title: Database exchange stalls after an MTU change
scenario: R1 and B2 share a direct point-to-point Ethernet link. The link supports IPv4 MTU 1500, both interfaces are up/up, and small pings work. B2 alone received an accidental ip mtu 1400 command. These excerpts are representative evidence. The compared interface on B2 is GigabitEthernet0/1.

exhibits.title: R1 OSPF neighbor
exhibits.text:
2.2.2.2  EXSTART/ -  10.0.12.2  Gi0/1
State repeatedly returns to EXSTART.

exhibits.title: Interface comparison
exhibits.text:
R1: 10.0.12.1/30, area 0, point-to-point, Hello 10, Dead 40, IP MTU 1500
B2: 10.0.12.2/30, area 0, point-to-point, Hello 10, Dead 40, IP MTU 1400

question: Which fault is supported by the evidence?
options: No DR exists on the point-to-point link.
B2 has an inconsistent IP MTU during database exchange.
The /30 subnet cannot carry OSPF LSAs.
B2 must use R1's router ID for synchronization.
explanation: The displayed MTUs differ even though the link supports 1500 and the other intended parameters agree. OSPF database exchange checks MTU; small ping success does not prove a large packet or DBD can be accepted. Restore the intended value and verify Full and the remote LAN route.
fix:
```ios B2
B2# configure terminal
B2(config)# interface gigabitethernet0/1
B2(config-if)# no ip mtu
B2(config-if)# end
B2# show ip interface gigabitethernet0/1
B2# show ip ospf neighbor
B2# show ip route ospf
```
This scenario explicitly states that 1500 is supported. If the underlying service requires a smaller MTU, agree a consistent supported value instead; do not bypass the check as a routine repair.

title: A copied timer template prevents shared-LAN neighbors
scenario: R2 and R3 are in the same Ethernet VLAN. Both /24 interfaces are up/up and bidirectional ping succeeds. R3 received an explicit 30/120 timer template; the intended shared-LAN design is 10/40. Output below is representative.

exhibits.title: R2 Gi0/2 interface
exhibits.text:
10.0.23.2/24, Area 0, Process 10, RID 2.2.2.2
Network Type BROADCAST; Hello 10, Dead 40

exhibits.title: R3 Gi0/2 interface
exhibits.text:
10.0.23.3/24, Area 0, Process 30, RID 3.3.3.3
Network Type BROADCAST; Hello 30, Dead 120

question: What must be repaired to establish the intended relationship?
options: Change one router to a new area for the VLAN.
Replace the /24 with a /30 mask on R3 only.
explanation: The Hello and dead values differ. The process IDs may differ, the shared area already matches, and changing one mask would introduce another fault. Restore the intended timer defaults and verify rather than promising an exact time to Full.
fix:
```ios R3
R3# configure terminal
R3(config)# interface gigabitethernet0/2
R3(config-if)# no ip ospf hello-interval
R3(config-if)# no ip ospf dead-interval
R3(config-if)# end
R3# show ip ospf interface gigabitethernet0/2
R3# show ip ospf neighbor
```
Confirm the effective timer pair is 10/40 and the expected adjacency reaches Full before saving.
